dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: Ah, heard that, did you? Sorry about that. I was just talking about some old friends from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: I'm often invited to perform and sing at some of their tribe's events when music or song accompaniment is required...

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: ...But those louts never show up to watch, even when I make the long, long trip over to where they are.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. Those old geezers are just like that.

dialogues.speaker: Anchieta
dialogues.text: Unless I write them a letter myself, there's no getting them to move — and I ain't doing that!
